comparison.objective: Read spine codes and shelve four books upright in alphabetical order.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch narrow protruding edges, lift and reorient books, then insert them into potentially occupied shelf gaps.
comparison.success_condition: All four books stand upright, spines outward, in alphabetical order. Numeric tolerances and damage criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Shelf insertion and semantic ordering are meaningfully different from impact-driven notch fracture and recovery of millimetre-scale fragments.
